item.title: Stop Renting Holes in Your Firewall
item.description: I spent an afternoon chasing a firewall rule that kept breaking, and the fix that finally stuck was deleting the port behind it off the public internet entirely. Source-IP allowlists are a maintenance treadmill that quietly rots into someone else’s access — here’s the inversion that ends it.
